# .agents

The agent setup of this repository, read by every coding agent.

<!-- mountaya-ai:agents-dir:begin -->
<!-- Generated by mountaya/ai (scripts/apply.mjs). Edit .agents/manifest.json instead. -->

## Layout

| Path | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `manifest.json` | The only hand-written agent configuration: plugins, MCP servers, permissions, the siblings a clone needs, how CI runs (its gate and deploy are the `ci`, `ci:quick` and `deploy` tasks of `mise.toml`). `node ../ai/scripts/apply.mjs` renders the rest from it. |
| `setup` | Sets a clone up to be worked in, asking before each step: `sh .agents/setup` (`--check` to report only). Rendered. |
| `siblings` | Pins the sibling commits CI builds against in `siblings.lock`: pre-commit stops while any sibling has uncommitted work or an unpushed HEAD, then pins each sibling whose HEAD moved forward (`sync`), pre-push stops a push carrying no lock or a pin CI could never fetch (`verify`), `status` and `pin` show and move the pins by hand, and a release runs `at-pins` before it commits and tags, which stops unless every sibling is checked out, clean and at its pin. Fetches them in CI from the bundles each sibling's CI publishes. Rendered. |

- **Own skills**, written for this repository: none.
- **Vendored skills**, third-party and pinned by `skills-lock.json`: none. Refresh them with `npx skills update`; never edit one in place without saying so here.
- **Linked skills**, owned by a sibling repository: none.

To vendor a skill, install it with `npx skills add <source> --skill <name>` so it lands in `skills/<name>/` and in `skills-lock.json`, then run `node ../ai/scripts/apply.mjs` to link it.

<!-- mountaya-ai:agents-dir:end -->
